title: Centralize daemon cause declarations so future emitters require an explicit recovery policy
outcome: Adding a production daemon failure cannot silently bypass an explicit in-session recovery decision.
acceptance: A shared named cause/policy declaration and product-level contract coverage require an explicit recovery decision for every relevant production emitter without source-grep tests; unknown external causes still fail closed and retry advice remains independent.

completion.summary: Typed local cause and handshake construction closed; exhaustive catalog and API-shape regressions retain unknown-wire compatibility and independent retry advice. Full gates passed and fresh dual25-path review complete; no remaining guard finding.
